scope: Offline native sidechain experiment using existing RNNoise/Silero speech context. VAD is not a trained sibilance classifier; no production DSP change or new weights.

models.training: No training or threshold tuning. Upstream training overlap with these recordings is unknown.

policy.score_receipt: Gate public30Hz diagnostics, only new observed counts update receipt. Apply only after receipt; age advances from initial snapshot and includes native100ms allowance. No future scores, backward interpolation or EOF padding. Deadline checked through the entire nominal10ms packet, including partial EOF, to preserve prefix invariance.
policy.fallback: Missing/unwarmed/invalid/uncertain/stale context selects classical key; returns smoothly after previous key attenuation. Confident low speech score protects by reducing key; high score permits relative policy. A VAD score is not a phonetic label.
policy.sidechain_note: Modulating a key can create filter transients. Key amplitude never exceeds original, but no claim that its filtered detector response or reduction is pointwise below classical. Native Range remains explicit.

evaluation.fixtures: Existing recorded manifest: s/sh/p one speaker, one violin, one cymbal. Development only. Group phonemes by their common speaker; level/topology variants are correlated.
evaluation.reference: Native Range0 through same topology, actual public delay and drain. Recursive minimum-phase ringing truncated by native drain; do not claim finite IIR support.
evaluation.measurement: Annotated full regions and active10ms windows; independent129tap Hann FIR LF0..2k, HF4..12k, unity passband scaling. Centered filtering is measurement-only.
evaluation.prefix: Four real neural traces/key prefixes, s and violin with both models at non-hop-aligned35001frames; native finalized-prefix tests exclude declared latency.

acceptance: Measure development behavior and incorrect suppression before selecting a realtime architecture. This limited corpus cannot establish classifier accuracy or justify production adoption.

deadline_correction.reason: Initial implementation checked age only at packet start and could retain an observation up to10ms past deadline. New boundary assertion reproduces failure; new code reserves whole nominal packet before using it. No model weights, confidence/band thresholds or fixtures changed.
